pr_title: [Feature] Add mxfp quant for token dispatch to fit low acc communication with MXFP4 fixed

rule.description: 在开发新功能（如 MXFP 量化 token dispatch）时，不应修改与功能无关的代码（如 `device_op.py` 中的其他逻辑）。如果其他人已经修复了某处代码，不应在 PR 中包含重复的修改。
checkpoints: 检查 PR 的 diff 是否包含与主要功能无关的代码修改
确认修改的代码是否已被其他人通过其他 PR 修复
在提交前对比 main 分支，确保不包含冗余变更

antipattern.code:
def _compute_mxfp_token_dispatch(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
        ...
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """Compute MXFP quantized token dispatch for MoE."""
        # Quantize hidden states to MXFP4 format
        quantized = self._mxfp_quantize(hidden_states)

        # Modified during MXFP feature development — this change
        # was not needed as someone else already fixed it elsewhere
        topk_weights, topk_ids = self._routing_compute(
            router_logits,
            quantized_scales=self._scale_cache,  #误改: 引入了不必要的 scale 缓存参数
        )

        return quantized, topk_weights, topk_ids
